Why local-first tools win

By Ada Lovelace · 2026-11-01

Local-first software keeps your data on your device. It works offline, survives outages, and avoids sending private documents to a server.

Three properties

  • Your data is yours.
  • The app works without a network.
  • Sync is optional, not required.

If the network disappears, the tool still works.

const local = true
PropertyCloudLocal
OfflineNoYes

That is why we built Graphock as a local-first desktop app with an optional cloud.
